Frontera Signal | Tijuana, Mexico

We are a NASA Space Apps 2026 team combining software engineering, AI, Earth science and creativity. We transform NASA open data into scientifically grounded tools with real-world impact. Our focus: harmonizing MODIS and VIIRS observations to study historical wildfire patterns in Baja California and beyond. We seek collaborators in Python, GIS, data science, web development, UI/UX and communication. We value teamwork, rigor and open-source innovation.
